interpretation: Retain exact P-2 nine, without claiming a same-model advantage. Role evidence and concentration motivate departures from model-preferred Pollard/Dike/Flournoy.
Spears improvement weakens one specific Pollard opportunity thesis; rest DNP itself is not a reason to downgrade Pollard.
Tyson/Meyers two LP days preserve uncertainty without inspected deterioration. Herbig absence and Smith return continue to challenge Pittsburgh, while Watt/Heyward FP counterbalance.
Official membership verification is an evidence-coverage improvement, not a slate switch or Sunday active certification.

alternatives.reason: Model prefers Pollard23.2 vs Williams17.9. Spears returning LP undercuts the absence-based workload thesis; Pollard DNP is rest, not injury deterioration. Preserve original receiving-outlier concern.
Model prefers Dike12.3 vs Ayomanor9.0; retained route counts comparable but attributed targets3 vs10 favor Ayomanor's observed involvement. Tate LP does not establish which receiver loses work.
Model prefers Flournoy12.2 vs Tyson8.7. Costs100 more, restores fourth DAL player ($26,100 DAL; $29,800 TEN–DAL), and prior trailing-script concern remains.

entries.lineup_effect: Hold49800/200, sixgames, DAL20800/TEN–DAL24500. New external model138.3, not backfilled. Model Pollard+Dike package146.9/48800 explicitly not adopted.
change_triggers: Tyson worsening participation or an explicit chest-related workload restriction prompts comparison with Flournoy; one LP alone does not force exit.
Meyers worsening ankle participation or a workload restriction requires a funded FLEX alternative.
Tate's progression plus credible role redistribution, rather than Tate's mere return, reopens Ayomanor/Dike/Restrepo.
Herbig availability and Philadelphia QB/receiver/protection changes reopen the defense comparison.
Spears final availability and supported Pollard workload could reopen Williams/Pollard; DNP is not OUT.
Official slate or eligibility mismatch requires an explicit correction.
carry_forward: Test model departures against opportunity and points separately; no unsupported claim the research beats the model.
Do not misread a rest DNP as an injury or a salary-export Q as a Friday game designation.
Before freeze verify Friday statuses, bind exact lineup/salary/model and expectation packets; no past clocks or records altered.
